job_alert_sources.name: Glassdoor
job_alert_sources.freshness: Each listing shows its age (Just posted / 5h / 1d / 12d); keep Just posted, hours, 1d, 2d or 3d.

job_alert_sources.name: Hunt UK Visa Sponsors
job_alert_sources.freshness: Digest of the latest jobs at sponsoring employers; it arrives only every few days, so read any digest from the last 7 days and rely on the duplicate check.

job_alert_sources.name: Newcastle University
job_alert_sources.freshness: Weekly digest; read any digest from the last 7 days and rely on the duplicate check.

target_roles: Reporting / MI / Data Quality Analyst (Power BI and Excel, no strong coding required)
Risk / Operations Analyst roles that welcome people from outside the field
avoid_roles: Data Analyst / BI / Data Science roles whose essential criteria are strong SQL or Python
Finance roles needing an accounting qualification (CIMA, ACA, ACCA)
locations: Anywhere in the UK, including Scotland (happy to relocate)

visa.notes: Time-limited right to work until January 2028. Contracts ending by then need no sponsor. For permanent roles, a licensed sponsor is strongly preferred; a non-sponsor permanent role is still shown but scored lower and flagged.

skill_limits.about: What the owner can honestly claim. Never score or write above this level.
skill_limits.sql: Working knowledge only (select, filter, join, group by). Counts as half-evidenced when an advert asks for SQL, and as NOT met when it asks for strong/advanced SQL.
skill_limits.python: Used in degree projects with AI assistance; cannot write it unaided. Counts as NOT met when Python is an essential requirement.
skill_limits.strengths: Requirements, business rules, process mapping, stakeholder work, user acceptance testing, Power BI, Excel, defining and delivering internal tools with AI coding assistants.

web_discovery.about: Jobs found on the web through Firecrawl, in addition to alert emails. See CLAUDE.md step 4b.

search_pages.name: Glassdoor: Business Analyst fixed-term contract, whole UK
search_pages.note: Keyword search: many results are permanent roles. Keep only adverts that say fixed-term, FTC, maternity cover or a 6-12 month contract, plus any junior/graduate business analyst role.

search_pages.name: Glassdoor: Junior Business Analyst, whole UK
Glassdoor: Operations Analyst, whole UK
search_pages.note: Wider net: keep operations, process, risk and improvement analyst roles that welcome graduates or people from outside the field.

search_pages.name: Glassdoor: Process Analyst, whole UK
search_pages.note: Catches transformation, process and junior BA roles that the business analyst search misses.

search_pages.name: NHS Jobs: analyst roles (admin and clerical), newest first
search_pages.note: Keep Band 4 to 6 business, reporting, information, PMO and data quality analyst roles; skip clinical coding, finance-qualified, service desk and Band 7+. Many NHS posts are fixed term. id prefix nh.

search_pages.name: Reed: junior business analyst, last 3 days
search_pages.note: Skip every 'Trainee ... no experience needed' advert from training providers (ITOL, Qualify Nation, etc.): they sell paid courses, they are not jobs. id prefix re.

search_pages.name: Reed: business analyst contract and temp, last 3 days
search_pages.note: Keep fixed term or temp employee roles; skip day-rate contractor roles (gate) and training-course adverts. id prefix re.

search_pages.name: Glassdoor: Graduate Business Analyst, whole UK
search_pages.note: Wide net: many results are senior despite the keyword; check experience asked.

search_pages.name: Glassdoor: Analyst fixed term contract, whole UK
search_pages.note: Fixed term analyst roles of any kind; keep reporting, data quality, operations, PMO and BA ones.

web_discovery.watchlist_query: "{employer}" careers ("business analyst" OR "junior business analyst" OR "graduate analyst" OR "PMO analyst" OR "reporting analyst" OR "operations analyst") UK
web_discovery.watchlist_note: Large employers with regular analyst hiring. Contracts fit any employer; for permanent roles licensed sponsors are preferred.

goal: Paid UK business analyst experience before the visa ends in January 2028. FIRST PREFERENCE: fixed-term contracts (FTC, maternity cover, 6-12 months) that end by January 2028 - fewer applicants see them as worth it, and the visa end date doesn't matter. Day-rate/inside-IR35 contractor roles are NOT this: they need years of experience and a limited company, so skip them. Fixed-term contracts of 12 months or less that end by January 2028: any employer is fine, sponsorship is irrelevant. Permanent roles: strongly prefer licensed Skilled Worker sponsors, because they are used to hiring people on visas and are less likely to pass over a time-limited right to work (and it keeps the option to stay open).
